language.name: English
app.title: Classroom 50
setup.title: Setup
settings.tools.title: Tools
settings.tools.hint: The toolbox works through git, the GitHub CLI and its Classroom 50 extension. Missing ones install through your package manager (Homebrew, winget, apt, dnf, pacman or zypper; on a Mac, git comes with Apple's Command Line Tools), which also keeps git and the GitHub CLI up to date.
setup.manual: The toolbox can't install {tool} on this computer: {reason}.
setup.manualReason.oldWinget: winget is out of date; update App Installer from the Microsoft Store
setup.manualReason.readOnlySystem: this system's packages are read-only; install it with Homebrew or in a toolbox
setup.manualReason.noPackageManager: no supported package manager found (apt, dnf, pacman, zypper)
setup.manualReason.noPkexec: pkexec (polkit) isn't installed, so the app can't ask for your password
setup.outdatedHint: This version is older than the toolbox needs. Update installs the current one.
setup.runYourself:
You can also run it yourself in a terminal:

{command}
projects.empty: No Classroom 50 assignments found yet. Sign in to GitHub, or add the folder where you keep your assignments.
update.readyHint: Restart now, or it installs when you quit the app.
update.deferredHint: It installs when you quit the app.
update.passwordHint: Restarting installs it and asks for your password.
update.restartHint: Restart the app to finish updating.
update.simulatedHint: Simulated: Restart now only writes to the log.
update.readyAnnounce: Version {version} is downloaded and ready to install
auth.notification.title: Signed in to GitHub
auth.notification.body: Classroom 50 Toolbox is now connected as {login}.
settings.folders.title: Assignment folders
settings.folders.hint: Scanned for Classroom 50 repositories, up to 4 levels deep.
settings.general.title: General
settings.reminders.title: Deadline reminders
settings.calendar.title: Calendar
settings.calendar.label: Due dates as a calendar file
settings.calendar.hint: An .ics file for Calendar, Outlook or Google Calendar, with an alert 1 hour before plus your reminders. Importing it again updates the events instead of doubling them.
settings.calendar.done.one: Exported {count} due date. Open the file to add it to your calendar.
settings.calendar.done.other: Exported {count} due dates. Open the file to add them to your calendar.
settings.calendar.kept: Kept up to date after each sync
settings.calendar.appHint: Adds your due dates to a calendar you pick, with an alert 1 hour before plus your reminders, and keeps them up to date.
settings.calendar.stopSync: Stop and remove the due dates
settings.calendar.openHint: Opens the due dates file in your calendar app to import it. Open it again after a change to import the new dates; most calendar apps update the events instead of adding them twice.
calendar.error.calendarAccess: The toolbox isn't allowed to use your calendars. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Calendars.
calendar.error.calendarUnavailable: Your calendar service didn't respond. Open your calendar app once, then try again.
settings.about.title: About
settings.dev.title: Developer
settings.dev.skinHint: Shows another platform's theme on this machine. The window backdrop stays this platform's.
settings.commitActions: Commit and push from the app
settings.commitActions.noneHint: Commit and push with git or your editor. The app only shows what's pending.
settings.commitActions.commitHint: Commit from a project's menu. Push with git or your editor.
settings.commitActions.pushHint: Commit from a project's menu, and push assignments graded on every push.
settings.dev.networkHint: Pretends GitHub is down (server errors) or the device is offline, until set back to Normal. Refresh to see it.
settings.dev.linkHint: Handles a classroom50-toolbox:// link as if the OS had opened it. Only bundled builds receive real ones.
settings.dev.hint: Dev builds only. Sends each kind of notification with made-up data.
settings.dev.badgeHint: Close the popover to see it; opening and closing it again clears it.
settings.quit.label: Quit
settings.quit.hint: Closing the window keeps it in the tray. Quitting stops syncs and reminders.
projects.firstSync.title: Finding your classrooms…
projects.firstSync.hint: Reading your classes, assignments and clones on GitHub and this computer. Only this first time takes a moment.
clone.exists: {error}. Move or rename that folder, or use Clone to… to pick another place.
projects.issue.rateLimited: GitHub rate limit reached. Showing the last known state.
projects.issue.notInstalled: Install the GitHub CLI to see your assignments on GitHub.
projects.issue.fallback: Couldn't reach GitHub. Showing the last known state.
settings.folders.editors: Find projects opened in your editors
settings.folders.editorsHint: JetBrains IDEs, VS Code and its forks, Zed, Sublime Text, Eclipse, NetBeans and Visual Studio
projects.unmergedBranches: Only on: {branches}. Merge into the default branch, which is what gets graded.
projects.pullHint: Someone pushed since your last pull. Pull before you keep working.
projects.gradingHint: The autograder is running on your last push. The grade shows up here when it's done.
projects.gradingFailedHint: The autograder couldn't grade your last push. Open the grading run to see why, or ask your teacher.
projects.lockedHint: Your teacher locked this assignment for now
projects.upcomingHint: Your teacher hasn't released this assignment yet
submit.confirm: This sends your committed work in {folder} to {branch} on GitHub as a new commit. Your local commits and branches stay as they are.
submit.uncommitted: Submit only sends committed work, and these changes aren't committed yet: {files}.
submit.commitElsewhere: Commit them in your editor or a terminal first, then submit.
submit.editorFiles: Editor and system files in the folder are sent too: {files}. List them in .gitignore to leave them out.
submit.remoteAhead: GitHub has commits this clone doesn't have. Submitting sends your files as they are, so changes made only on GitHub are undone. Pull first to keep them.
submit.remoteAheadBy: GitHub has commits this clone doesn't have (the latest by {author}). Submitting sends your files as they are, so changes made only on GitHub are undone. Pull first to keep them.
submit.unchanged: Nothing changed since the last push: this grades the same work again.
submit.late: The due date has passed, so this submission will be marked late.
submit.noMarker: This assignment has no autograder setup to submit through. Commit and push your work with git instead.
submit.noMarkerPush: This assignment has no submit setup: every push to GitHub counts as your submission. Commit and push your work instead?
submit.done: Submitted. The autograder runs now, and the grade shows up here when it's done. Your clone is now one commit behind GitHub: click Pull to get the submission commit.
push.title: Commit & push
push.large: Large files (over 50 MB) included: {files}. GitHub may warn about them.
push.ahead.one: Your {count} commit not on GitHub yet is pushed too.
push.ahead.other: Your {count} commits not on GitHub yet are pushed too.
push.pushOnly.one: Push your {count} commit to {branch} on GitHub? It will be graded.
push.pushOnly.other: Push your {count} commits to {branch} on GitHub? They will be graded.
push.late: The due date has passed, so this push will be marked late.
push.lateConfirm: The due date has passed, so this push will be marked late. Continue?
push.identity: Git needs a name and email to sign your commits. Use {name} <{email}> for this clone? The email is your private GitHub address, so your real one stays hidden.
push.otherBranch: This clone is on another branch. Switch to {branch} to commit and push there, since only {branch} is graded.
push.remoteAhead: GitHub has commits this clone doesn't have. Pull first, then commit and push. If Pull refuses because of your changes, commit and merge from your editor or a terminal.
push.gitInProgress: A merge or rebase isn't finished in this clone. Finish or abort it in your editor or a terminal first.
push.nothingToPush: Nothing to push: there are no changes and GitHub has all your commits.
push.noIdentity: Git doesn't know your name and email yet. Set user.name and user.email with git config, then try again.
push.fileTooLarge: GitHub refuses files over 100 MB, so nothing was committed: {files}. Remove them or add them to .gitignore.
push.pushRejected: GitHub refused the push because someone pushed in the meantime. Your commits stay in the clone: merge GitHub's changes from your editor or with git pull, then push again.
commit.title: Commit
commit.noPush.tagMode: Only commits in this clone: this assignment is graded through Submit.
commit.noPush.closed: Only commits in this clone: submissions are closed.
commit.noPush.otherBranch: Only commits in this clone: push is offered on {branch}, the graded branch.
commit.noPush.remoteAhead: Only commits in this clone: GitHub has newer commits to merge before you push.
commit.noPush.notOnGitHub: Only commits in this clone: this repo isn't in your GitHub list yet. Refresh, or switch to the account that owns it.
commit.noPush.disabled: Only commits in this clone: push is turned off in Settings.
commit.noPush.fallback: Only commits in this clone: push isn't available for this project.
commit.nothingToCommit: Nothing to commit: there are no changes in this clone.
pull.localChanges: You have changes that aren't committed yet. Commit them first, then pull, so they're not mixed with the new commits.
pull.otherBranch: This clone is on another branch. Switch to {branch} to pull the new commits.
pull.diverged: Both your clone and GitHub have new commits, so they need to be merged. Pull from your editor or with git pull, and solve any conflicts there.
accept.confirm: This creates your repository for this assignment in {classroom} on GitHub:
accept.repoPrivate: {repo}, private, owned by the classroom's organization {org}, not by your account.
accept.repoPublic: {repo}, public, owned by the classroom's organization {org}: your work, commits and GitHub name will be visible to anyone.
accept.feedbackPr: A Feedback pull request is opened where your teacher can comment on your work.
accept.everyPush: Every push to the default branch counts as a submission.
accept.tagMode: Only what you submit counts: each Submit is tagged and graded.
accept.due: Due {date}. Work after that is marked late, never refused.
accept.inGroup: You're in {group}, which shares this repository.
accept.thenClone: Then the app offers to clone it.
accept.group: Group assignment: only one member accepts it, then invites the others to the repository.
accept.teamTeacher: Team assignment: your teacher assigns the groups. If you aren't in one yet, ask them to add you first.
accept.teamStudent: Team assignment: your group shares one repository. If a teammate already created your group, ask them to add you before accepting; otherwise you name a new group.
accept.needsTeam: You aren't in a group for this assignment yet. Name a new group to create it: you become its founder and can add your teammates. If a teammate already has a group, cancel and ask them to add you instead.
accept.groupNamePlaceholder: Group name, for example The Sharks
accept.createGroupHint: Name your new group. You become its founder: you accept the assignment for the group and add your teammates.
accept.groupCreated: {group} is created and you're its founder. Add your teammates now? You can also do it later with “Add to my group…” in the assignment's menu. Once added, each teammate accepts the assignment too.
accept.done: {repo} is ready. It shows up in the list after the next sync.
accept.cloneNowTo: {repo} is ready. Clone it now into {folder}?
link.title: Classroom 50 Toolbox
link.finishSetup: Finish setting up the app first, then open the link again.
link.needsTools: The app needs the tools listed under Setup before it can follow this link. Install them, then open the link again.
link.needsSignIn: Sign in to GitHub first (at the bottom of the window), then open the link again.
link.noProject: {repo} isn't in your list. It may show up after the next sync, or belong to another GitHub account.
link.noAssignment: The class {classroom} has no open assignment named {assignment}. Check the link with your teacher.
link.openAssignment: Open the assignment {assignment} of {classroom}? The app then reads the class's published assignment list.
link.cloneNow: {repo} isn't on this computer yet. Clone it now?
link.cloneNowTo: {repo} isn't on this computer yet. Clone it now into {folder}?
alerts.due.title: {assignment} is due {when}
alerts.due.body: Make sure your work is committed, pushed and on the default branch.
alerts.grade.title: New grade: {assignment}
alerts.gradingFailed.title: Grading failed: {assignment}
alerts.gradingFailed.body: The autograder couldn't grade your last push. Open the assignment to see why.
alerts.feedback.title: New feedback: {assignment}
alerts.feedback.body.one: Your teacher left a comment on your feedback pull request.
alerts.feedback.body.other: Your teacher left {count} comments on your feedback pull request.
alerts.newAssignment.title: New assignment in {classroom}
details.submissionMode.every-push: Every push to the default branch
details.failedTestsHint: Failed tests (Open grade details shows why)
alerts.teammatePush.title: {author} pushed to {assignment}
alerts.groupJoined.body.one: {assignment}: they can push to your shared repository now.
alerts.groupJoined.body.other: {assignment}: they can push to your shared repository now.
alerts.deadlineChanged.title: Deadline changed: {assignment}
alerts.closed.title: Submissions closed: {assignment}
alerts.updateReady.title: Version {version} is ready
alerts.updateReady.body: Open Classroom 50 Toolbox to restart and finish updating.
settings.sync.title: Sync
auth.addAccountNeedsGh: Add another account (install the GitHub CLI first)
auth.openAt: Or open {url} in a browser and type the code.
auth.openFailed: No browser could be opened. Open {url} yourself and type the code.
auth.needsScopes: Classroom 50 needs more access to your GitHub account to accept and submit assignments.
auth.expired: The code expired. Sign in again to get a new one.
auth.envToken: The GitHub CLI is using the {var} environment variable, so it can't sign in from here. Remove {var} from your environment and restart the app.
auth.signOutConfirm: Sign {login} out of the GitHub CLI on this computer? The terminal is signed out too.
projects.filter.label: Show
projects.conflictHint: A teammate pushed while you have uncommitted or unpushed work. Pull now to avoid a merge conflict.
projects.lateHint: Graded work is dated after the deadline. Nothing is blocked; your teacher sees it as late.
projects.issue.offline: You're offline. Showing what was last synced.
settings.editor.label: Editor
settings.editor.hint: For clones no editor has opened yet. Others open where you last worked on them.
settings.editor.none: No supported editor found. Install one and it shows up here.
teammate.teamHint: They get push access to {assignment} through your group. Several usernames can go in at once, separated by commas or spaces.
teammate.inviteHint: They get a GitHub invitation to push to {repo}. Several usernames can go in at once, separated by commas or spaces.
teammate.teamDone: {user} is in your group now. They should accept {assignment} next.
teammate.inviteDone: {user} got an invitation to push to {repo}.
teammate.teacherForms: Your teacher assigns the groups for this assignment: ask them to add classmates to yours.
teammate.notFounder: Only the group's founder can add members, and you didn't found this group.
teammate.askFounder: Only the group's founder can add members: ask {founders} to add your classmates.
a11y.pulled: Pulled: {name} is up to date with GitHub
settings.hidden.label: Hidden assignments and classes
settings.hidden.hint: Assignments: {count}, classes: {classes}. Left out of the list and never notified about; search still finds them.
welcome.title: Welcome to Classroom 50 Toolbox
welcome.lead: Your Classroom 50 assignments, one click away in the tray.
welcome.point.list: Every assignment in one list, with its due date, grade and what still needs pushing or submitting.
welcome.point.actions: Accept, clone, pull and submit without the terminal, and open your work in your editor.
welcome.point.notify: Reminders before deadlines, and a notification when a grade, feedback or a teammate's push arrives.
welcome.tools.title: Tools
welcome.tools.missing: Classroom 50 works through git, the GitHub CLI and its gh student extension. Install what's missing; it takes a minute.
welcome.tools.ready: git, the GitHub CLI and gh student are installed. You're set.
welcome.account.needsGh: Signing in goes through the GitHub CLI. Go back to Tools and install it first.
welcome.account.title: GitHub account
welcome.account.hint: Sign in with the account your classes know you by. Your browser opens with a one-time code; the app keeps no copy of your token.
welcome.folders.title: Your code
settings.diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
settings.diagnostics.hint: A report to paste into a GitHub issue when something goes wrong
settings.diagnostics.masked: Accounts, organizations, classes, repositories, names, emails and your home folder are replaced with placeholders. Check the report before you share it.
error.notInstalled: `{program}` is not installed or not on PATH
error.needsTeam: you are not in a group for this assignment yet
error.submissionsClosed: submissions are closed for this assignment
error.invalidTeamName: a group name needs 1 to 80 characters, on one line
error.diverged: the clone and GitHub have both changed
error.tokenFromEnv: the GitHub CLI is using the {var} environment variable; unset it to sign in here
error.noSelfUpdate: this copy of the toolbox can't update itself; download new versions from GitHub
